lines.zh: 翅膀嗡嗡，我贴着沙子飞。
lines.en: Wings buzzing, I skim above the sand.
Six legs tucked under my shell to save strength.

lines.zh: 我绕开墓碑，不想惊动主人。
lines.en: I circle the tombstone and leave its master be.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就滑过去一段。
lines.en: One gust and I slide a good distance.
My shadow on the sand is very small.
I fly low to follow the scent.

lines.zh: 甲壳反光，像一小块金子。
lines.en: My shell glints like a scrap of gold.

lines.zh: 我绕着石棺转，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle the sarcophagus, again and again.

lines.zh: 不远不近，跟着那个走路的。
lines.en: Not too near, I follow the walking one.

lines.zh: 沙里的骨头是我的路标。
lines.en: The bones in the sand are my signposts.

lines.zh: 我振翅的声，木头都能听见。
lines.en: The sound of my wings carries even through wood.

lines.zh: 我往有腐肉味的方向飞。
lines.en: I fly toward the smell of carrion.
Do not reach out when I fly low.

lines.zh: 我绕了远路，只是不想撞墙。
lines.en: I took the long way only to avoid walls.

lines.zh: 我跟着沙上的脚印飞一段。
lines.en: I follow the footprints in the sand a while.

lines.zh: 风起时，我躲在石堆后面。
lines.en: When the wind rises I shelter behind stones.

lines.zh: 我停在石头上，收拢翅膀。
lines.en: I settle on a stone and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 壳上的尘土，我慢慢搓掉。
lines.en: I slowly rub the dust off my shell.
I clean my forelegs as if polishing blades.
The buzzing stops, and the world goes quiet.
I wait for my master's command.

lines.zh: 太阳烤着沙，我躲在阴影里。
lines.en: The sun bakes the sand; I hide in shade.

lines.zh: 我听见地下有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something moving underground.
A crack in my shell, nothing serious.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一枚旧纽扣。
lines.en: I sit still as an old button.

lines.zh: 那只蝎子离我远点就好。
lines.en: That scorpion just needs to keep its distance.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里映出整片墓园。
lines.en: The whole graveyard shows in my compound eyes.
Wings spread to dry, waiting for the next flight.
You carry a living one's heat.
I land on your shoulder. Do not be alarmed.

lines.zh: 你的心跳真响，我听得清。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud; I hear it clearly.
I circle you twice.
Look up. I am above your head.
You stepped on my path.
I mean no harm; I only follow orders.
Your eyes are tracking me.
Do not swat; I fly faster than that.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头顶，数你的睫毛。
lines.en: I circle above your head, counting your eyelashes.
My shell has a dent.
I hit the ground, then climb up again.

lines.zh: 一只翅膀歪了，飞得打转。
lines.en: One wing is bent; I fly in circles.
My shell is dented, but I can still crawl.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口绿色的东西。
lines.en: I spit out something green.

lines.zh: 我的薄翅被拍歪了一边。
lines.en: One of my thin wings has been knocked crooked.
My buzz dropped. I am hurt.
I hide in a crack to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜一抖，沙子都落下来。
lines.en: I flick my wing membrane and sand falls off.
My shell rings like broken pottery.
The smell of carrion. I know it.
Lower the meat and I will come down.
Not sweet things; I want something rank.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块肉转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle that meat three times.

lines.zh: 我的口器很小，得慢慢啃。
lines.en: My mouthparts are small; I must nibble.

lines.zh: 别急着收手，我还没吃饱。
lines.en: Do not pull your hand away; I am not full.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在动，真好。
lines.en: What you hold is moving. How nice.

lines.zh: 我闻到了埋在地下的味道。
lines.en: I smell something buried below.
This will keep me chewing all day.
I must save a share for my master.
I hit you and flipped over.
My shell is hard; your hand is harder.

lines.zh: 翅膀被压了一下，嗡声变了。
lines.en: A wing got pinched; my buzz changed pitch.
Do not block with your hand; I will go around.
I slipped out through your sleeve.
A little knock will not stop my flight.

lines.zh: 你身上的布挂住我的腿了。
lines.en: Your cloth caught one of my legs.
I right myself and fly on.

lines.zh: 撞歪了，我重新对准方向。
lines.en: Knocked off course, I line up again.
Do not flick me; my shell rings all day.

lines.zh: 我的同类都在沙下产卵。
lines.en: My kind lay eggs beneath the sand.
In this graveyard, I am the liveliest.

lines.zh: 我要找一只翅膀完整的。
lines.en: I want one with unbroken wings.
My buzzing is my courtship.
Once the eggs are laid, I return to watch.
My brood lies under the sand.
Do not tread that sand; eggs are there.

lines.zh: 我们从不拥抱，只碰触角。
lines.en: We never embrace; we touch antennae.
One is enough for me.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在石棺边上等我。
lines.en: My mate waits by the sarcophagus.

lines.zh: 我抱起一粒沙，飞不动了。
lines.en: I lift a grain of sand and cannot fly.
This bone shard, I can drag it.
I grip the thread with my forelegs.
Too heavy; I try with another leg.

lines.zh: 地下的东西，我拖回巢里。
lines.en: What is underground, I drag back to the nest.
This bead will plug the nest hole nicely.
I am not greedy; I take one mouthful.
The thread you dropped, I will take.
Both forelegs lifting keeps it steady.
If it is too heavy, I chew it apart here.
My master pointed at you, so I come.
The mummy hunts you, and so do I.
Your scent cannot get away.
I rise a little to see clearly.
The target is small, but I am not picky.
My compound eyes split you into pieces.
Your breathing shows me the way.
I am ordered to bite you once.

lines.zh: 你迈出第一步，我已经起飞。
lines.en: You take one step, and I'm already airborne.

lines.zh: 沙里的脚印，我全看见了。
lines.en: I see every footprint in the sand.
This time it is my turn.
You are standing in my master's way.
I circle behind you, then dive.
My wings speed up; the buzz turns sharp.
I fix on your neck.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我就动了。
lines.en: When you look up, I move.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，找落点。
lines.en: I circle overhead, looking for a place to land.
Height is enough; the angle is too.

lines.zh: 你挥手的方向，我记住了。
lines.en: I noted the way you swat.

lines.zh: 我贴地飞，躲开你的视线。
lines.en: I fly low to stay out of your sight.
After three circles, I drop.
My legs are already spread.

lines.zh: 你脚跟离地了，就是现在。
lines.en: Your heel lifted. Now.
Do not look up too long; it will dizzy you.
I bite behind your ear.
The bite is small, but deep.
My mouthparts are two tiny pincers.
You slapped air; I already flew off.
A bead of blood rises, and I taste it.
I paused at your collar.
It stings? That was only the first bite.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇得你睁不开眼。
lines.en: My wings keep you from opening your eyes.
You cannot catch me; I am too small.
After biting, I drop into the sand.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的沙还没抖干净。
lines.en: Sand still clings to my wings.
The mummy called me here.
I squeeze out of a crack in the tomb.
Once my wings dry, I take off.
The air here is dry and old.

lines.zh: 古代的木乃伊不要普通圣甲虫。
lines.en: The ancient mummy wants no common scarab.
I shake the sand off my shell.

lines.zh: 墓园里又多了一只嗡鸣。
lines.en: One more buzz in the graveyard.
I am here, master.
First thing: find my bearings.

lines.zh: 火烧到翅膀，我闻到自己焦了。
lines.en: Fire reaches my wings; I smell myself burning.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，鞘翅裂了缝。
lines.en: I hit the stone, and a crack splits my wing case.
In water I cannot fly, only sink.
The blast folded my wings.

lines.zh: 箭擦过壳，留下一道白痕。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my shell and left a white line.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的嗡声压没了。
lines.en: Magic pressed my buzzing into silence.
Hunger makes my wings tremble.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我的复眼发白。
lines.en: Lightning flashed and my eyes went white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，我无处落。
lines.en: No sand in the void, nowhere to land.
